{"action":"proof","message":"  have hfactor : 80325 = 3^2 * 5^2 * 7 * 17 := by norm_num
  rw [hfactor] at h₁
  have h17 : 17 ∣ n ! := by
    exact (Nat.Prime.dvd_factorial (by norm_num) ).2 (by omega)
  have hbound : 17 ≤ n := by
    have := (Nat.Prime.dvd_factorial (by norm_num)).1 h17
    exact this
  exact hbound"}
